scope: Read-only exact-branch audit of populated contact, website, and opening-hour values prioritized for possible staleness. No value was cleared solely because a source omitted it. Only first-party operator or mall sources considered. No workbook edits, paid sources, or Mapbox calls.

sources_checked.evidence: The Causeway Point #01-38/39 4FINGERS listing states 10:00am–10:00pm across the listed day columns. It matches the catalogue hours, but its dated/event context limits its value for confirming the current evergreen schedule.

limitations: This bounded audit reviewed three exact-branch opening-hour values; it does not establish directory-wide freshness of the 2,708 contacts, 2,819 websites, or 1,488 hours.
No phone or website was changed because the retrieved exact-branch official sources did not establish that an existing value was false or invalid. Source omission alone is not evidence of invalidity.
The Causeway Point source is event-dated and is weak evidence for an evergreen schedule; the existing hours were left unchanged pending a current exact-branch source.
